how_to: Add ONLY places a ShadowMap team member has checked in person. Never add a place from memory, a guess, or from Google Maps content (Google's terms forbid copying it).
category must be one of: police, hospital, clinic, pharmacy, fuel, atm, transit, food_shop, hotel.
lat/lon: stand at the entrance and read the coordinates from a GPS app or by long-pressing the spot on the OpenStreetMap website. Say which in 'note'.
opening_hours uses OpenStreetMap style, e.g. "24/7" or "Mo-Su 08:00-22:00". Write it ONLY if you confirmed the hours (sign on the door, or asked staff). Otherwise null.
verified_on is the date you checked it (YYYY-MM-DD). verified_by is the team member's name. Confidence drops after 30 and 180 days, so re-check before the demo.

If the place is already on OpenStreetMap, you may add "osm_id": "node/123" (from the OSM link in the app) so it is merged with that entry. Without it, ShadowMap merges only when category, position (within 25-60 m) and name clearly agree.
After editing, rebuild the map: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.build_map (only possible before any Sentinel photos or reports exist).

Example entry (copy, then edit): {"name": "...", "category": "pharmacy", "lat": 26.08, "lon": 91.56, "opening_hours": null, "phone": null, "osm_id": null, "verified_by": "...", "verified_on": "2026-10-31", "note": "Checked on site; coordinates from GPS app"}
